title: Urinary tract infection and pyelonephritis

steps.tx: Uropathogenic strains of **Uropathogenic Escherichia coli** (**UPEC**) account for **75%** to **85%** of all community-acquired uncomplicated urinary tract infections. UPEC expresses **type 1 fimbriae** that bind mannosylated uroplakin receptors on superficial bladder umbrella cells to facilitate colonization, alongside pyelonephritis-associated **P fimbriae** that mediate renal parenchymal tissue invasion.

right.title: P Fimbriae (Pap) Actions
points: Essential virulence factor for parenchymal invasion

steps.tx: Outpatient management of acute uncomplicated pyelonephritis incorporates oral **fluoroquinolones**, such as **ciprofloxacin** **500** mg twice daily for **7** days, provided local regional resistance remains below **10%**. Alternatively, an initial intravenous dose of **ceftriaxone** followed by oral **trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole** for **14** days provides excellent antimicrobial eradication.

nodes.label: Ciprofloxacin 500 mg BID for 7 days if resistance < 10%
IV ceftriaxone plus TMP-SMX for 14 days as alternative

steps.tx: The presence of **Asymptomatic bacteriuria**, defined by isolation of >= **10^5** CFU/mL of a single bacterial species in two consecutive clean-catch voids without urinary symptoms, requires antimicrobial eradication **ONLY** in pregnant individuals and patients undergoing invasive urological procedures breaching the urothelial mucosa, avoiding unnecessary resistance.

left.title: Mandatory Treatment Indications
points: Screening recommended at 12 to 16 weeks gestation

steps.tx: Severe **Emphysematous pyelonephritis** is a life-threatening, necrotizing gas-forming infection occurring almost exclusively in patients with poorly controlled diabetes mellitus. Microbial fermentation of high tissue glucose concentrations by gas-producing organisms, predominantly **E. coli** or **Klebsiella pneumoniae**, generates intraparenchymal carbon dioxide and hydrogen gas bubbles.

vis.caption: Suppurative renal parenchymal infection and microabscesses in pyelonephritis (StewardMD).

steps.tx: The computed tomography **Huang and Tseng classification** stratifies emphysematous pyelonephritis to guide surgical intervention: **Class 1** exhibits gas confined to the collecting system; **Class 2** displays gas in the renal parenchyma; **Class 3A/3B** denotes extension into the perinephric or pararenal space; and **Class 4** indicates bilateral disease or infection in a solitary kidney.

steps.tx: Chronic destructive **Xanthogranulomatous pyelonephritis** (**XPN**) develops secondary to longstanding urinary obstruction and recurrent infection associated with a massive **staghorn calculus**. Histological analysis demonstrates extensive parenchymal replacement by sheets of lipid-laden **foamy macrophages** (xanthoma cells), frequently mimicking locally invasive renal cell carcinoma on cross-sectional imaging.

steps.tx: Ischemic **Renal papillary necrosis** manifests with sudden severe flank pain, gross hematuria, and sloughing of necrotic papillae causing acute ureteric obstruction. Predisposing clinical conditions are remembered by the classic mnemonic **POSTCARDS** (pyelonephritis, obstruction, **sickle cell disease**, tuberculosis, cirrhosis, **analgesics**, renal transplant, diabetes mellitus, and systemic vasculitis).

right.title: Imaging Hallmarks
points: Ring shadow sign on retrograde pyelogram

steps.tx: Urogenital infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis produces classic **sterile pyuria** accompanied by persistent microscopic **hematuria** and acidic urine pH. Longstanding disease triggers progressive fibrotic scarring, manifesting on intravenous urography as infundibular strictures, calyceal amputation, and extensive dystrophic calcification termed a **putty kidney**.
